paite: Tu in, na thilgelh thute uh zaw, "Pasal a ding in numei khoih louh ahoih hi."
heading: Kitenna Thu A Dotna

paite: Himahleh kingaihna a-om nak ziak in pasal chih in ama zi chiat nei henla, numei chih in leng ama pasal chiat nei hen.
Pasal in azi kiang ah atan ding hun pia hen; huchi mah bang in zi in leng apasal kiang ah atan ding hun pe sam hen.
Zi in ama pumpi tung ah thu anei kei a, apasal in thu aneizaw hi; huchi mah bang in pasal in leng ama pumpi tung ah thu anei kei a, azi in thu aneizaw hi.

Thum ding a na kipiak theihna ding uleh, na kikholh nawn theihna ding ua sawt lou kal a dia pha na sak tuaktuak kei ngal uleh akuamah mah kizangsak kei un, huchi lou in zaw na kidek zoh louh ziak un Setan in ahon khem kha ding hi.
Himahleh hiai thu thupiak dan hilou in phal lam thu in ka gen zaw ahi.
Ke'n bel, mi tengteng keimah bang a a-om vek uh ka deih ahi. Himahleh michih in Pathian a kipan thilpiak amau muh lam anei chiat uhi; khat in lam tuam ah khat in lam dang in.
Himahleh koppih neiloute leh meithaite kiang ah huchi in ka chi ahi; keimah bangtak in om le uh amau a ding in ahoih ding hi.
Kidektheihna aneih kei ualeh kiteng uhen; huk sang in kiten ahoihzaw hi.
Huan kitengsate kiang ah thu ka pia, keimah bel hilou in, Toupa piak ahi zaw; zi in apasal khen kei hen;
akhen vanglakleh pasal nei nawn lou in om vanglak hen, ahihkeileh, apasal toh mah kituak nawn uheh; huan pasal in azi ma kei hen.
Midang kiang ah ahihleh Toupa hilou in keimah in ka gen; unau kuapeuh in zi, gingloumi kitenpih leh akiang a om gige a-utleh, ma kei hen.
Huan numei pasal ginglou kitenpih in, apasal in akiang a om gige a-utleh ma kei hen.
Pasal gingloumi azi ziak in hihsiangthou in a-om a, zi gingloumi leng apasal ziak in hihsiangthou in a-om sam ahi; huchi hita keileh, na tate uh asiangthou kei ding uhi; himahleh asiangthou na uhi.
Himahleh aging lou pen in akhenleh khen mai hen, huchibang ah zaw unaupa hiam, unaunu hiam, hen ahita kei ding. Pathian in lemna ah ahon sam hi.
Zi aw, na pasal na hotdam ding leh ding louh bangchi in na thei a eita? Pasal aw, na zi na hotdam ding leh ding louh bangchi in na thei a eita?
Himahleh, Toupa'n michih kiang a apiak bang chiat leh Pathian in michih asap lai a a-omdan bang chiat in om hen. Huchibang in saptuam pawl tengteng ah ka hihkip hi.
heading: Pathian Hon Sapna A Om Ding

paite: Zeksumsa a sap a-om uhia? Zeksum louh hong hi tuan kei uhen. Zeksum louh a om sap a-om uhia? Zeksum tuan dah uhen.
Pathian thupiakte zuih lel louh ngal zeksum i chih bangmah ahi kei a, zeksum louh leng bangmah ahi kei hi.
Michih sap a a-om lai ua atan ngeina uah om chiat uhen.
Sikha hisa a sap na hi hia? Khawk sa tuan ke'n. Na suahtak theihleh sensuk in.
Sikha hisa a om Toupa sap Toupa sikha noplen ahi a; huchi mah bang in noplen sa a sap Khrist sikha ahi.
Man a lei na hita ua mihingte sikha ah lut kei un.
Unaute aw, michih sap a a-om lai bangbang in Pathian kiang ah om gige hen.
Huan nungak siangthou lam thu ah zaw Toupa thupiak himhim ka nei kei; himahleh muanhuai a om ding in Toupa kiang a kipan zahngaihna mu ka hih ziak in ka ngaihtuahdan ka gen ding.
heading: Kitengloute Leh Meithaite Thu

paite: Tulai haksatna ziak in pasal a-omdan ngeingei bang in omleh amah a ding in hoih in ka gingta hi.
Zi a hen na hi hia? Kisutkhiak tum ke'n. Zi a hen louh na hi hia? Zi zong ke'n.

Himahleh zi na neihleh thil na hihkhial kei hi, nungak siangthou in leng pasal aneihleh thil ahihkhial sam kei hi. Himahleh, hichibang mite'n sa ah gimna athuak ding uhi; himahleh ke'n zaw hon thuaksak louh ka ut hi.
Himahleh unaute aw, hiai ka chi ahi; hun seh atomta; zi neite nei lou bang a a-omtheihna ding un;
kapte kap lou bang a a-omtheihna ding un leh kipakte kipak lou bang a a-omtheihna ding un;
khovel zangte zang lo zen lou a a-omtheihna ding un; hiai khovel omdan lah amangthang gige ahi.
Lungzinna nei lou a na om uh ka hon deih hi. Zi nei lou pasal in Toupa lungkimsakna ding in, Toupa lam thilte alimsak hi.
Zi nei pasal in bel azi lungkimsakna ding in, khovel thilte alimsak hi.

Pasal neisa leh nungak siangthou kilamdanna a-om hi. Pasal nei lou numei in apumpi leh kha asianthoudan ding, Toupa lam thilte alimsak a; pasal nei numei in bel apasal lungkimsakdan ding, khovel lam thilte alimsak hi.
Nou phattuamna ding in hiai ka gen ahi; na tung ua khamna nga hilou in, navak a na omna ding uleh Toupa kiang a na kipiakna uh bukimna ding in ahi zaw.
Kuapeuh in azikham tung a gamta diklou hi a akigintak a, alunggulhna a let ngal a akulleh, hoih asak bang in hih hen aw; kiteng uhen, khelhna ahi kei.
Himahleh kuapeuh alungtang a thu khensat a, alou thei lou khop a kulna nei hilou a, amah kithuzohmi in asianthouna kepbit atup tintenleh ahihhoih ding.
Huchi in nungak kitenpihpa'n ahihhoih a; himahleh zi nei lou dia amah kikham in ahihhoih zaw ding hi.
Zi zaw apasal adam lai teng hen ahi; himahleh apasal asihleh bel adeih peuh anei thei ding a, himahleh Toupa a ommi ahih ding ahi.
Himahleh kei ngaihdan in, a-om ngei in om gigeleh nuam asa zaw ding; ke'n Pathian Kha nei sam in ka kithei hi.
